verdict.rationale: Sierra's own docs say agents are grounded in the customer's knowledge data (Help Center content, FAQs, policies). Insights lets you see the knowledge sources behind every agent answer, which covers both grounding and source attribution. missing for 10: documentation that source citations appear inline in answers shown to end users, enforcement that every answer is restricted to grounded content, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, every answer is grounded in my own content and shows which article or source it drew from

citations.quote: View, manage, and edit knowledge data such as Help Center content, FAQs, and policies that ground your agent.
Understand the reasoning behind every agent action or answer—view knowledge sources, systems accessed, and more.
